// Blood II's weapon classes and the constants a mod's
// Mod\WeaponClasses.txt can set for them. GENERATED by `testBlood2Tables
// --dump weaponclasses` from Blood2/ObjectDLL/BloodModWeaponClasses.cpp; do
// not edit, regenerate.
//
// A section is a weapon's WEAP_ name, as in Weapons.txt.  Every weapon
// takes MultiDamageBoost, DamageType (a DAMAGE_TYPE_ name) and AltAmmoType
// (an AMMO_ name), and an environment-mapped one Chrome, over its class's
// constructor's values, and
// a weapon with a pickup PickupAmmo and PickupName over its pickup's;
// those are not listed here.  With Mod\AI.txt's [Options] Trace = TRUE
// the server prints them.  Below are the literals in the code that a
// mod can change, with retail's values: every weapon's MuzzleSmoke,
// MuzzleLight and Fragments, for its hits with BULLET, SHELL or BMG
// ammo, and a melee weapon's HitFragments (CWeapon::UpdateWeaponFX), and
// one class's own.  Blood2/ObjectDLL/BloodModWeaponClasses.h has the rest.
